test_title: PYST 128: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 25 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, BLUSH is written as ‘EPXWK’, and SPLASH is written as ‘VTOEVL’. How will ‘SPRITE’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8984df74927dfe0e33fd053d789979e7393726c759ecce513787d8256d0c53cc.png] 

**Logic:** Addition of (3) and (4) alternatively in the position value of the alphabet.

BLUSH is written as 'EPXWK' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e0150457a3ffda1652c9e25653ce1551fd19eb7aa29abd75294b1866308866d.png] 

SPLASH is written as ‘VTOEVL’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7111577ef2e5d332f04b2bc253c50bf274a068c4191786fb360b2fb7b8adf531.png] 

Similarly, 'SPRITE' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7be77770aefd730050c465a6818731dbccecb4d951be7c5008fcf91b418df5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**VTUMWI**".
